testEntries.title: E2E Test Life Lesson
testEntries.content: This is a test life lesson entry created during E2E testing. The most important lesson I learned was to always verify your tests clean up after themselves.

testEntries.title: E2E Test Family Story
testEntries.content: This is a test family story entry. Every year, our family would gather for E2E testing to ensure the application worked perfectly.

testEntries.title: E2E Test Advice
testEntries.content: Here is some test advice for future developers: Always write comprehensive E2E tests before shipping features.

testEntries.title: E2E Test Tradition
testEntries.content: Our family has a tradition of running automated tests every morning. It keeps us grounded and ensures quality.

testEntries.title: E2E Test Values
testEntries.content: Quality and reliability are values we hold dear. These tests represent our commitment to excellence.

testCoreBeliefs.title: E2E Test Belief 1
testCoreBeliefs.description: Testing is not optional, it is essential for quality software.

testCoreBeliefs.title: E2E Test Belief 2
testCoreBeliefs.description: Automated tests save time and reduce bugs in the long run.
